name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: 'data_fd2_' game-global prefix, 'audio' domain, 'bgm_last_set_track_id' descriptor accurately names the content (a cache holding the most recently set BGM track id). No Ghidra address residue; the name reflects a scalar id-cache. Sole accessor fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade reads it (MOVZX byte @0x25982) and writes it (MOV AL @0x25997), confirming purpose.
purpose: 1-byte mutable cache of the most recently requested BGM track id, used by fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade to skip reloading a track that is already playing.
logic_summary: On a track-change request, fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade compares this byte (zero-extended via MOVZX) against the requested track id; if equal it is a no-op (already playing), otherwise it stores the new id (MOV AL) and proceeds with stop/load/init/fade of the new sequence. Init value 0xFF zero-extends to 0x000000FF so it never collides with the 0xFFFFFFFF fade-out/stop request, guaranteeing the very first real track request always triggers a load.
element_semantics: Single unsigned 8-bit BGM track id (FDMUS.DAT index). 0xFF = no track set yet (sentinel). Compared against / assigned from the low byte of the 32-bit track_id parameter.
comment_original_issue: src comment said 0xFF was 'the stop sentinel'; that conflated the init value with the 0xFFFFFFFF fade-out/stop request. The accurate point is that 0xFF zero-extends to 0x000000FF and thus never equals the 0xFFFFFFFF stop request.
notes: Sole accessor fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade: READ @0x25982 (MOVZX byte, change-detect compare vs [ESP+8]), WRITE @0x25997 (MOV AL, store new track). Game write-xref present -> NOT const. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was already correct and consistent with src (no change). Separately removed a STALE/INCORRECT PRE_COMMENT on this data address: it claimed '0x53EF0 = current_bgm_track_id (AIL handle state)', but disasm shows 0x53EF0 is the driver-available flag (MOVZX+TEST+JZ driver check @0x259ba); data plates must live in PLATE_COMMENT per project rule, and the PLATE already carries the correct doc, so the duplicate erroneous PRE was cleared.
